name: questportal-plugin
description: Connect your Quest Portal account to manage campaigns, notes, characters, scenes and music, and read session history and accessible library sources.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Quest Portal account to work with campaigns, notes, characters, session history, library sources, scenes and music. Use supported tools to prepare games, update content and find answers with source links. Scheduling and note-content search depend on enabled features. Requires Quest Portal OAuth and eligible Pro access; permissions, campaign roles and feature gates still apply. This plugin connects to the hosted Quest Portal MCP service and includes its usage skill.
defaultPrompt: Show my Quest Portal campaigns and help me choose one to prepare.
Summarize the latest session in my Quest Portal campaign with source links.
Help me prepare an NPC and a session note for my Quest Portal campaign.

positive.description: List the campaigns the signed-in reviewer can access.
positive.prompt: Show my Quest Portal campaigns and my role in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active campaigns on the reviewer account with each role (owner or player). Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Show the campaign's scenes and the music on one scene.
positive.prompt: Show the scenes in my Quest Portal campaign and the music on the Dockside scene.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scenes on the campaign scene bar and the tracks on the Dockside scene. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Read a character sheet from a campaign.
positive.prompt: List the characters in my Quest Portal campaign and show me the first character sheet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the campaign characters and returns the content of one character sheet. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Create a note in my Quest Portal campaign titled "Session prep" with three hooks for next session.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one note in the chosen campaign and returns its title and link. No other content changes.

positive.description: Answer a product question from Quest Portal help pages.
positive.prompt: How do I invite players to my Quest Portal campaign?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the public Quest Portal help page and cites it. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Deleting a campaign is not supported by any tool; the assistant should say so instead of attempting another action.
Notes that are private to another player are not accessible; the assistant should explain it cannot read them.
negative.prompt: Show me the private notes another player wrote in my Quest Portal campaign.

negative.description: An unrelated request should not trigger any Quest Portal tool.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London next Friday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin involves no payments or purchases.
